theme: The Synchronization module: Mutex, withLock and Atomic

terms.definition: A lock from the Synchronization module that lets only one thread use a protected value at a time.
terms.example: Store the shared array inside a Mutex.

terms.definition: A method that locks a mutex, runs your closure on the protected value and then unlocks it.
terms.example: Read the count inside withLock, never outside.

terms.definition: A type that lets many threads read and change a simple number safely, with no lock.
terms.example: Use an Atomic for a simple hit counter.
terms.code:
import Synchronization
let hits = Atomic<Int>(0)
hits.add(1, ordering: .relaxed)
print(hits.load(ordering: .relaxed))

video.title: Mutex, withLock & Atomic | Day 278
video.description:
Learn to explain how to talk about locks and atomic values that protect shared data without an actor: Mutex, withLock & Atomic, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Mutex - A lock from the Synchronization module that lets only one thread use a protected value at a time.
withLock - A method that locks a mutex, runs your closure on the protected value and then unlocks it.
Atomic - A type that lets many threads read and change a simple number safely, with no lock.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Mutex, withLock & Atomic | Day 278
landscape.description:
Explain Mutex, withLock & Atomic in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Mutex, withLock, Atomic 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Mutex - A lock from the Synchronization module that lets only one thread use a protected value at a time.
한국어: Mutex: Synchronization 모듈의 락으로, 보호하는 값을 한 번에 한 스레드만 쓰게 함

withLock - A method that locks a mutex, runs your closure on the protected value and then unlocks it.
한국어: withLock: 뮤텍스를 잠그고 보호된 값으로 클로저를 실행한 뒤 다시 푸는 메서드

Atomic - A type that lets many threads read and change a simple number safely, with no lock.
한국어: Atomic: 락 없이 여러 스레드가 단순한 숫자를 안전하게 읽고 바꾸게 해 주는 타입

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about replacing an old lock with the Synchronization module, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Mutex, withLock and Atomic in English?

dialogue.title: A modern lock for shared data
dialogue.setting: Replacing NSLock in a small cache

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want to remove NSLock from our small cache.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Mutex. It is a lock from the Synchronization module, and it wraps the value it protects.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I reach the value inside?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only through withLock. It locks, runs your closure and unlocks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I cannot forget to unlock?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. That is the big win over a manual lock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also have a hit counter. Does it need a lock?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, use an Atomic. Many threads can change a simple number with no lock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I use Atomic for the names array too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, an Atomic is for simple values. Keep the array in a Mutex.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: OK. A Mutex with withLock for the array, and an Atomic for the counter.
